name: com.exerussus.nexus
description: Editor-feature engine: deployable plugin pages, static services, theme. All mutable data lives OUTSIDE this folder — deployed code in Assets/Plugins/NexusStates, project config in ProjectSettings/Nexus.json, personal data in UserSettings/Exerussus.Nexus — so the package can be read-only / updated cleanly. Plugin roots can live anywhere (Assets or packages): mark a folder with nexus-plugins.json and press «Найти корни плагинов» in Manage.
